mechanism_under_test.baseline: generation plus replay token/certificate, with token reuse allowed after a generation number cycles
mechanism_under_test.candidate: pointer authority tuple (epoch, generation, nonce, effect_digest) plus a certificate containing the identical tuple; every pointer mutation increments epoch and uses a fresh nonce; replay requires exact pointer-certificate tuple equality and the referenced native effect digest; pointer mutation is conditional on the currently observed pointer version
mechanism_under_test.repair_order: certificate-first for the proposed fresh epoch/nonce, then conditional pointer install; replay remains fail-closed until pointer and certificate exactly agree

steps: read the current pointer and the immutable native-effect digest

probe_result: PASS within deterministic single-writer/conditional-update symbolic scope: generation+token alone is ABA-vulnerable when a generation number and token are reused; adding a strictly monotonic pointer epoch plus a fresh nonce, exact certificate equality, and certificate-first conditional pointer repair rejects stale 20->19->20 authority resurrection while preserving E_native.
scope_guard: This proves only the explicit symbolic pointer/certificate state machine under serialized role-local conditional updates and deterministic native-effect identity. It does not prove distributed consensus, malicious-writer resistance, cryptographic nonce unpredictability, repository transport atomicity, multi-writer linearizability, or recovery from corruption of E_native itself.
neuroscience_transfer: The safe reconstruction rule separates content identity (E_native) from recency/context authority (monotonic epoch plus fresh nonce): a familiar content state may recur, but recurrence does not restore an old temporal-context tag. This is a state-machine transfer claim only, not evidence that a specific biological circuit implements this repository protocol.

mechanism_assessment.accepted_scope: deterministic serialized role-local recurrence reconstruction with ABA rejection
